answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 7227 Country: India Title: I have passed class 12th and seeking admissions in engineering.nearly i have got an admission in bharti vidya peeth university in pune.i just want to know that is it better for me or not.please help me i am totally confused about it. Question: salam alaikum I have passed class 12th and seeking admissions in engineering.nearly i have got an admission in bharti vidya peeth university in pune.i just want to know that is it better for me or not.please help me i am totally confused about it. Answer ID: 7227 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1070/936=L/1429) There is no wrong in acquiring engineering education if it is possible with following the religion and observing the salah, sawm and other obligations. If it is difficult to protect Eiman in the college then it will be unlawful to get admission there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
